report: Day 1 is in. The post with a number in the headline pulled the highest click-through per day; the LinkedIn story post got impressions but almost no engagement; the Instagram story landed in the middle with likes but few clicks. Recommendation: make numbers the default hook, lead with X, and cut LinkedIn to once a week until it earns its place.
findings: The numbered headline wins on ctr_per_day because the figure is the hook
The LinkedIn story had the most impressions but the lowest ctr_per_day; a story without a hook does not travel there
Likes on the Instagram story were strong but clicks lagged, so the CTA in bio is losing people

recommendations.action: Put a number in every headline and make X the lead channel
recommendations.why: The numbered X headline was the clear winner on ctr_per_day

recommendations.action: Rewrite the next posts to open with a figure, keep the story format for Instagram only
recommendations.why: Numbers drove clicks; stories drove likes but not clicks

recommendations.action: Move ad budget from LinkedIn to X
recommendations.why: LinkedIn had the highest cost per signup, X the lowest

message_to_team: Bram, day-1 report is on the bus: the numbered X headline won on CTR, LinkedIn story post lost. Revise the plan: numbers first, X leads, LinkedIn to weekly. Lena gets the details from you.
